title: RAG-TESTER: Automated End-to-End Testing of Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
author: arXiv cs.AI
summary: RAG-TESTER proposes an automated framework for end-to-end testing of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. It generates diverse test cases and evaluates RAG pipelines on retrieval accuracy and answer quality, enabling robust quality assurance for RAG-based LLM applications.
